oyācati.p: [ava + yāca + a + ti] (kri) Google Translate He desires in vain; Cursed.

P: Oyācati，[o + yāc，opp．āyācati] to wish ill，to curse，imprecate Vin．III，137．（Page 169）
R:
oyācati：ဩ-ယာစတိ （ဩ√ယာစ်）
အယုတ်အားဖြင့် တောင်း၏။ ကျိန်ဆဲ၏။
DOP: oyācati pr. 3 sg. [o 2 + yācati], curses, imprecates ; Vin III 137, 19 (itthiyo … evaṃ ~anti evaṃ duggato hotu … yathā mayaṃ duggatā); 137, 27 (ekaccānaṃ itthīnaṃ ~antīnaṃ).
CPD: ( o-yācati ), pr. 3 sg. [ < *ava + √yāc], to wish ill, to curse, to imprecate ( opp. āyācati, q. v. ); aññā pi itthiyo asantuṭṭhā sassūhi vā sasurehi vā sāmikehi vā tā evaṃ ~ anti, Vin lll 137, 19 ; assosuṃ kho bhikkhū ekaccānaṃ itthīnaṃ-antīnaṃ, 137, 27 .
